description: This file defines a syntax highlighter class for Proguard files in an IntelliJ IDEA plugin, specifying how different token types are highlighted.

classes.name: ProguardSyntaxHighlighter
classes.description: A syntax highlighter for Proguard files, mapping token types to text attributes for syntax coloring.

methods.name: getHighlightingLexer
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ProguardLexer for tokenizing Proguard files.

methods.name: getTokenHighlights
methods.description: Returns the text attributes for a given token type to determine syntax highlighting.
